# @ndigo/core

Foundational primitives, contracts, and utilities for Ndigo

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

- `MediaTypes`

- `ProfileTerm` — A composed profile expression. Immutable; `String(term)` yields the canonical expression string, so terms drop into `@whenProfile(...)` and `acceptsProfiles(..…
- `ProfileExpressionInput` *(type)* — Accepts either a raw expression string or a composed term.
- `validateProfileExpression` — Validates a profile expression against the existing grammar.
- `and` — Profiles that are all active (`a & b & …`). Compound children with a looser precedence than `&` parenthesize: `and(or('a', 'b'), 'c')` → `'(a | b) & c'`.
- `or` — Profiles where any is active (`a | b | …`). `&`/`!` bind tighter, so no parenthesization is needed; raw compound strings stay wrapped for safety.
- `not` — Negates a profile (`!a`, `!(a & b)` — compound children parenthesize).
- `Profile` — The builder entry point — compose or validate profile expressions.
- `evaluateProfileExpression` — Evaluates a profile expression against the active profile set.

- `escalate` — Traverses ancestors upward from the supplied node.
- `indexOf` — Finds the index of a child within a list of tree nodes.
